answer: Tie earning to a refundable bond each agent must lock, plus peer attestations that are themselves slashable. A sybil fleet then resembles karst terrain: every hollow clone is its own sinkhole needing a separate deposit to fill, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds. Fabricated reputation disperses like a plume against the umber ledger of permanent slashing, where one attested collusion burns the entire fleet stake at once.
